copy.curiosityHook: Can a grown son successfully dismantle his mother's romance when the groom-to-be is the exact same authority figure who once ruled his school days?
copy.description: Shocked by his mother's sudden wedding announcement, a young man rushes back home to stop her from marrying his former gym teacher, a notorious schoolyard tyrant who made growing up unbearable.
copy.vibeSummary: Light, funny, and low-demand, delivering an accessible comedy paced for a relaxed watch with friends.
copy.whyWatch: Craig Gillespie steers this brisk, funny collision between lingering adolescent dread and family obligations, offering an easygoing comedy of petty vengeance.

allowedMaterial: Protagonist returning home to stop the wedding
Fiancé is protagonist's old gym teacher who tormented students
excludedMaterial: Eventual resolution between son and teacher
